description: Global Hubs provides a CSV and Parquet ranking of large freight railway operators. Dmitry Golubnichiy documents net freight tonne-kilometres as the ranking measure and includes a year, source and indicative revenue fields. The README says North American short-ton-miles are converted to tonne-kilometres and that road haulage is outside the list. The public Zenodo concept DOI and repository state CC0, so access is free. A rail modeller could use the operator-scale quantities to set broad freight-activity baselines or compare capacity exposure, provided they separately obtain the actual routes and service pattern. Each record is a railway company, not a network link or dated movement. Reference years can differ, and the documentation does not make the rankings a consistent simultaneous census. This review did not inspect rows, audit conversion values or check every original source. Related Global Hubs datasets cover terminals, shipping lines and other freight modes. For simulation, this operator list needs separately sourced route topology and a common reference period.
